name: Conservation & Restoration of Key Habitats Program
summary: Regional programme funding conservation and restoration of mangroves, seagrass, coral reef pressures and tropical dry and wet forests across the six Dutch Caribbean islands. Local conservation organisations apply in competitive rounds; the first round is done and a new call is expected in 2027.

status.quote: A new Call for Proposals is expected to open in 2027, offering another opportunity to apply for funding through the Key Habitats Program.

applicant_types.quote: Following a call for proposals that invited conservation organizations across the Dutch Caribbean to submit projects aligned with the program's long-term goals

geography.quote: The Key Habitats Program covers all six Dutch Caribbean islands
